stories.title: Martha Elena, hija de Paquita la del Barrio, es despedida en Xalapa; falleció a los 47 años

en.title: Martha Elena, daughter of Paquita la del Barrio, is laid to rest in Xalapa; she died at age 47
en.summary: Martha Elena, daughter of Mexican singer Paquita la del Barrio, passed away at 47 years old. Her funeral took place in Xalapa, with local authorities extending condolences to the family.

stories.title: La asimetría de la vida: cuando la química del laboratorio aprende a imitar a la naturaleza

en.title: The asymmetry of life: when laboratory chemistry learns to imitate nature
en.summary: This year's Nobel Prize in Chemistry honors researchers for solving how to make synthetic chemical reactions produce single molecular forms that mirror nature's chirality. The breakthrough has applications in safer pharmaceutical manufacturing and reveals insights into life's origins on Earth.

stories.title: Rays despachan a Yankees; un jonrón y una interferencia de fanático definen la serie

en.title: Rays eliminate Yankees; a home run and fan interference define the series
en.summary: The Rays defeated the Yankees in a series where a home run and a fan interference play proved decisive in determining the outcome.

stories.title: Programa de Ordenación no modificará impuesto predial o valores catastrales, asegura Sedatu; "no tiene atribuciones fiscales ni recaudatorias"

en.title: Land Management Program will not modify property tax or cadastral values, Sedatu assures; "has no fiscal or collection authority"
en.summary: Mexico's Sedatu agency clarified that a land management program will not change property taxes or cadastral assessments. The secretariat stated that vacant land will not be auctioned without owner consent.

stories.title: El boom de los podcasts en México llega al video

en.title: The podcast boom in Mexico reaches video
en.summary: Mexico's podcast audience has grown from 5 million in 2016 to 49 million in 2025, with video emerging as a transformative format for production and consumption.

stories.title: Ariadna Montiel llama a la unidad, a actuar con austeridad y sin frivolidades; pide respaldar a Sheinbaum en los XV años de Morena

en.title: Ariadna Montiel calls for unity, acting with austerity and without frivolities; asks to support Sheinbaum at Morena's XV years
en.summary: A Morena party leader called for unity and austerity during the party's 15th anniversary celebration, requesting support for Sheinbaum while honoring Andrés Manuel López Obrador's legacy.

stories.title: Alcalde de Nueva York participa en vigilia por 7 de octubre; israelíes y propalestinos lo llaman "traidor"

en.title: New York mayor participates in October 7 vigil; Israelis and pro-Palestinians call him "traitor"
en.summary: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani participated in a vigil related to October 7, drawing criticism from both Israeli and Palestinian protesters who voiced opposing accusations.

stories.title: Nissan Frontier Pro PHEV 2027: esto cuesta en México la pick-up híbrida enchufable que Nissan trae desde China

en.title: Nissan Frontier Pro PHEV 2027: this is what the plug-in hybrid pickup that Nissan brings from China costs in Mexico
en.summary: Nissan introduced the 2027 Frontier Pro PHEV in Mexico with prices from 899,900 to 969,900 pesos, offering 75 kilometers of electric range and 350 horsepower combined output.

stories.title: Andy López Beltrán acude a los XV años de Morena; se sienta en las primeras filas del Auditorio Nacional

en.title: Andy López Beltrán attends Morena's 15th anniversary at National Auditorium; sits in front rows
en.summary: Andy López Beltrán attended Morena's 15th anniversary celebration held at the National Auditorium, where he was seated in the front section.

stories.title: Acude 'Andy' a festejo por los XV años de Morena

en.title: Andy attends Morena's 15th anniversary celebration
en.summary: Andy López Beltrán attended the 15th anniversary event for Morena held at the National Auditorium.

stories.title: Nissan Frontier Pro PHEV; así es el primer híbrido enchufable de la marca

en.title: Nissan Frontier Pro PHEV; the brand's first plug-in hybrid this way
en.summary: Nissan introduced the Frontier Pro PHEV, expanding its Frontier lineup and electrified vehicle offerings with a plug-in hybrid pickup truck.

stories.title: Morena cumple 15 años; AMLO no acudirá al festejo

en.title: Morena Marks 15 Years; AMLO Will Not Attend Celebration
en.summary: Mexico's Morena party is holding a 15th anniversary event at the National Auditorium with party founders and elected officials, though the president will not attend.

stories.title: Estados Unidos redujo una quinta parte de los envíos de gas natural a México por 10 días

en.title: United States reduced one-fifth of natural gas shipments to Mexico for 10 days
en.summary: The U.S. reduced natural gas exports to Mexico by twenty percent over a ten-day period due to scheduled maintenance on a pipeline, according to Mexico's gas authority.

stories.title: Un Tesla correrá la Panamericana para probar hasta dónde llega la infraestructura de carga en México

en.title: A Tesla will run the Panamericana to test how far charging infrastructure reaches in Mexico
en.summary: A Tesla Model S will travel over 4,000 kilometers between Tuxtla and Zacatecas to evaluate the viability of electric vehicle travel in Mexico and identify opportunities for expanding charging infrastructure.

stories.title: La jornada de 40 horas exige un registro electrónico y las multas pueden llegar a 586,550 pesos

en.title: The 40-hour workday requires electronic registration and fines can reach 586,550 pesos
en.summary: Mexico will require companies to electronically register employee entry and exit times starting in 2027, with potential fines for non-compliance as labor authorities continue defining implementation rules.

stories.title: Comprar un Chevrolet Aveo nuevo es hasta 25,200 pesos más barato que comprar uno usado

en.title: Buying a new Chevrolet Aveo is up to 25,200 pesos cheaper than buying a used one
en.summary: A promotional offer on the Chevrolet Aveo LS manual model makes purchasing a new vehicle more economical than buying used models advertised at higher prices despite accumulated mileage.

stories.title: BBVA México va por los millonarios del país: busca crecer 33% su banca patrimonial hacia 2029

en.title: BBVA Mexico targets the country's wealthy: seeks to grow its wealth management banking 33% by 2029
en.summary: BBVA Mexico, the largest financial group operating in the country, plans to expand its wealth management segment from over 180,000 clients to 240,000 clients within three years while managing 1.3 trillion pesos.
